topic: What happens to your body in a heat wave?
title: How heat attacks the body
hook: What happens to your body in a heat wave?

beats.label: HOUR 1
beats.line: Hour one. You sweat buckets to cool your body down.

beats.label: HOUR 3
beats.line: Hour three. Your heart pumps harder to push heat out through your skin.

beats.label: HOUR 5
beats.line: Hour five. You feel dizzy and sick. That's heat exhaustion.

beats.label: HOUR 6
beats.line: Hour six. If your core hits forty degrees, your brain gets confused.

beats.label: HOUR 7
beats.line: Hour seven. Heat stroke can strike, and you may stop sweating.

end.line: Stay cool out there. Where's the hottest place you've been?

description: Hour by hour: how a heat wave pushes your body from sweating to heat stroke.

facts.claim: Sweating cools the body; heart rate rises to move heat to the skin.
Heat exhaustion: dizziness, nausea, heavy sweating, weakness.
Heat stroke: body temperature 40°C (104°F) or higher with confusion; sweating may stop; medical emergency.
